data.title: Request to submit vacation preferences for January–June 2027
data.summary: Your employer, Druckerei Beispiellahn GmbH, asks all staff to enter their vacation wishes for the first half of 2027 into a list (in the break room or employee portal) within 10 working days of the letter dated 18 November 2026, so shifts can be planned.
data.explanation: This is a routine HR request, not a legal notice. Your employer wants to plan shift schedules for the first half of 2027 and needs your preferred vacation dates. Add your wishes to the list in the break room or the employee portal by the deadline shown by the app. The letter does not state what happens if you miss it, but it is in your interest to submit on time so your preferences can be considered when shifts are planned. No payment or legal consequence is involved.
